title: Twitch Follower Alert
blurb: Somewhere between dopamine and interruption sits the follower alert, and every streamer has a complicated relationship with it. The chime fires mid-sentence, mid-fight, mid-anything, and the streamer has to acknowledge it or look ungrateful. A great deal of stream comedy has been built on badly timed alerts for that reason. Viewers know it as Pavlovian confirmation that somebody just joined. Use it in edits about streaming, prank a friend playing something tense, or set it as a phone notification and enjoy the illusion that your personal life is growing a community.
origin: The classic follower-alert chime from Twitch streaming culture.
